To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we could identify two different clusters of illness behavior in our sample of patients with medically unexplainable physical symptoms, which were related to health anxiety and gender.
we could identify two clusters of patients with MUPS, one with high and one with low illness behavior, and that the high illness behavior group was characterized by more health anxiety.
the heterogeneity of MUPS patients can be explained by their illness behavior and that this behavior is associated with health anxiety.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the heterogeneity in illness behavior in patients suffering from MUPS and the related variables.
a more differentiated understanding of illness behavior and its determinants in patients with Mumps.
the development of a better understanding of the heterogeneity of MUPS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the pattern of illness behaviors in patients with Mumps differs in regard to the degree of illness behavior and that the pattern differs between sexes.
patients with a high illness behavior are more likely to have health anxiety and are more likely to be women.
the illness behavior of patients with MUPS is heterogeneous, and that the pattern of illness behaviors is influenced by gender.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the illness behavior is heterogeneous and is related to health anxiety.
patients who have been diagnosed with a physical illness, but have no physical explanation for their symptoms (MUPS) are more prone to engage in different illness behaviors.
health anxiety and sex are important factors in understanding the heterogeneity in illness behaviors in MUPS patients.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the pattern of illness behaviors is heterogeneous in patients with MUNS and should be considered as an important factor in the assessment of patients and in the development of psychological interventions.
the heterogeneity of patients with MUPS should be taken into account to improve the treatment of patients with MUS.
the heterogeneity of the MUPS population should be acknowledged in research and practice.
